g.text: The tape is a ZIPPER, and its left context is stored REVERSED: `<[1,_] | 0 | [0,1]>`
THE TAPE AS THE READER IMAGINES IT (head marked)
` vec![One, Blank],` <- `l` : the left context, NEAREST CELL FIRST
` vec![Zero, One] )` <- `r` : the right context, NEAREST CELL FIRST
`l[0]` is the cell IMMEDIATELY LEFT of the head,
so reading the strip leftwards walks `l` FORWARDS.
`l` in slot order, so the surface `[1,_]` means
"1 is adjacent to the head, _ is one further out".
does not exist in the value.

when `r` is empty. That body never runs.
Both `Vec(Sym)` fields collapse to ONE OPAQUE DEBUG STRING each.
The engine cannot see into a tape context, cannot match inside it,
and has no inverse for it — which is why `__mettail_dovetail_build_tape_d`
emits no arm for `Tape_Tp` and every reconstruction of a `Tape` returns
